name: Render
description: Client-side visuals only: highlights for items, projectiles, TNT and the block you aim at, plus a setting toggle that turns view bobbing off. Nothing here sends packets.

addons.NoBob: Turns off view bobbing while enabled and gives the setting back when disabled.
addons.ItemESP: Highlights dropped items through walls within a chosen range, in the theme colour.
addons.ProjectileESP: Highlights arrows, fireballs, ender pearls and other thrown items through walls, each in its own colour.
addons.TNTTimer: Outlines primed TNT through walls and lists the closest ones with the seconds left on their fuse.
addons.BlockOverlay: Outlines the block your crosshair is on. Follows the silent rotation, so it shows what your clicks would hit.
